verdict.rationale: Xero has official SDKs (xero-node with full method coverage, OpenAPI descriptions) plus a documented AI Toolkit including OpenAI Agents SDK, MCP Server, and LangChain support and prompt examples, directly enabling AI-native developers to build against official SDKs. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration of SDK quality and completeness beyond first-party docs, and llms.txt returns 404 suggesting some AI-facing doc surface gaps.
